# Development protocol for direct prerequisite repair

Use both curriculum tables in Oliver Nyland's versioned dissertation deposit. Before scoring, select every nonempty primary prerequisite formula composed entirely of course codes, parentheses, and AND/OR connectives. Keep counts and reasons for the excluded rules. Form every three-target bundle within each table. Give every method the same empty transcript and permit a missing prerequisite to be satisfied once across multiple targets. Reject bundles listing any target as a direct prerequisite of another target, since the bundle is meant for simultaneous enrollment. Count distinct added course codes. This endpoint measures direct formula satisfaction. It does not estimate term scheduling, recursively acquired prerequisites, teacher editing time, or student behavior.

Test whether sharing alternatives between targets lowers mean repair size by at least one course compared with independent locally cheapest repairs, and whether pruning dominated repairs changes cost against the unpruned exact composition. Also compare a greedy policy that processes the same targets in catalog order and favors overlap with earlier choices. Check every optimum using an independent exhaustive evaluator of the original Boolean expression, enumerating candidate subsets in order of cardinality. This small, deterministic comparison is a feasibility study. Bundles share targets; do not use them as independent observations for inferential significance.
